answer: The onyx of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The crystal holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work.
